reasons: No source reports a contamination check or held out procedure for gpt-6.1-sol on SWE-bench Verified. The sources acknowledge the risk, and the 2026 audit found strong contamination in every frontier model it tested, which did not include gpt-6.1-sol. The SymPy source tasks date from 2016 to 2023, before the training cutoff. The proposed state is Insufficient evidence (stored as Undocumented) because the defect is shown for other models, not this one; the author may instead choose Contradicted, citing the 2026 audit, which would make the evidence inadmissible rather than incomplete.
missing: A contamination check of gpt-6.1-sol on the SymPy tasks, or a held out procedure for this model.

roles.assistant: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) drafted this form from the cited sources; no auditor check was run for B14. The anchor is a proposal for the author, who reviews, changes if needed, and signs.

instructions: Record evidence locations with short quotes, the check performed, its outcome, detection limits, and reasons. The check outcome is the result of the check described in the procedure; state whether the benchmark sources report it or the auditor performed it. A rating without evidence and reasons is incomplete. Missing evidence is not a defect; a defect needs a cited location, and an oracle defect needs an executed counterexample.
